ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between a low-intensity (near-black) background and high-intensity (near-white) localized circular features; low-intensity pixels occupy >85% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base pigmentation is continuous. High-contrast white circular rings are distributed as focal spots: approximately 22 distinct rings on the left lobe and 32 on the right lobe, primarily clustered near the distal tips and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate interior pixel angle of 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge displays continuous small-scale irregular peaks and valleys; average pixel-amplitude is low (<5 pixels), with higher frequency serration density observed toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges follow a convex parabolic curve extending from the central notch to the pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast white rings (5-15 pixels in width) against the dark ventral surface; spatial mapping shows high density at the distal ends of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent vertical-diagonal linear mark (white pixels) on the mid-left lobe; several shorter, low-contrast horizontal linear disruptions visible on the inner-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across both lobes; irregular jagged edge and minor indentation visible on the far right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The unique 'ringed' texture created by concentrated white circular scars against a uniform dark field constitutes a highly distinct visual pattern.
